digest.component_or_area: LLM gate cost analysis and infrastructure observability
propositions: Per-run LLM costs measured: plan-review $3.02, code-review $1.42, completion-verifier $2.24; mean per-ticket $11.85
Cheap-model experiments (Nova Pro, Haiku, Nova Lite) identified blocking-criteria recall loss and output-token ceiling errors, with Nova Pro disqualified on false-accepts
Code-review severity axes are inert because blocking is routed by criterion (98.2% disabled), not severity; 0.95 threshold is structurally unreachable (max observed impact 0.60)
Deprecation registry is complete; only gitattributes migration arm is expired; single-pass review and REBAR_LLM_MODEL are removal-ready post-v0.11.0 in a breaking window
Two probe defects in observability.sh cause false-positive alarm firings: cold-start offset inflation (widespread-zealous-narwhal) and over-broad grep pattern (colossal-slothful-grouse)
Deploy-defer budget marginally undersized; all four Aug-12 review-interrupt firings exceeded bound by 10-130s, indicating DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX should be raised to prevent review kills
